newsitem.title: USA: OPTIONS - FX vols ease in pre-weekend U.S. trade.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS - FX vols ease in pre-weekend U.S. trade.

text.p: Implied volatilities for dollar-pair options were pressured by weekend time-decay in typical Friday U.S. trading as the spot dollar retraced losses of the last few days, dealers said.

The dollar/mark volatility curve, which has been inverted for weeks, flattened as the relatively rich front end was deflated, with the dollar bouncing off early lows near 1.68 marks but still well below Tuesday's highs above 1.70.
"For a person sitting on an options desk and watching the spot market, it (dollar/mark's topside) looks kind of heavy," said a trader at a European bank in Chicago.
